name: pulse8
description: Pulse.8, a small groovebox built on the webdsp engine

scripts.vst:build: cmake -S vst -B vst/build && cmake --build vst/build --target Pulse8_VST3 -j 4
scripts.vst:e2e: cmake -S vst -B vst/build -DPULSE8_BUILD_E2E=ON && cmake --build vst/build --target Pulse8Harness -j 4 && vitest run --config vst/vitest.config.ts
